FAQ

What matters most for hood-cleaning shops?Reliable scheduling of recurring stops and fast replies when a restaurant has an urgent inspection. A missed call often goes to the next cleaner on Google.
Jobber or Kickserv?Jobber has clearer published pricing and a wider feature set. Kickserv is aimed at small service companies; confirm pricing on their site.
How do I invoice restaurants quickly?Invoice Simple or Wave from your phone. Sync into QuickBooks later if your accountant wants it.
